observations: Photo 0 shows a white chest freezer with a large front sticker reading NEXUS and a small metal NEXUS badge on the upper right
The sticker shows polar bears, vegetables, and feature icons but the model number is not legible
A padlock with key is attached to the lid handle
A temperature control dial is visible at the bottom right front
Photo 1 shows the open interior with a metal liner, a white plastic basket, and visible staining at the bottom corner
Both photos carry the watermark POSTED ON JIJI ADEBAYO ELIZABETH

claims.evidence: model number not legible in either photo

risks.risk: Does not power on or cool
risks.proof: video of the freezer running with the dial turned and interior temperature dropping
close-up video of the dial being adjusted and compressor responding

risks.risk: Interior liner damage beyond visible staining
risks.proof: well-lit video panning the full interior walls and floor

risks.risk: Lock or key does not work
risks.proof: video of the key locking and unlocking the lid

proof_requests: Video of the freezer powered on and cooling
Close-up of any model or serial plate
Video of the key operating the lock
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Nexus chest freezer from the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case as non-working; the unreadable model number does not prevent identification by type.
